sections.title: Form and origin
sections.text: Lychee is an evergreen tree native to southern China and neighbouring parts of Southeast Asia. It is usually under 19 m tall, but can grow taller.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The small, petal-less flowers grow in panicles. The fruit is a rounded drupe with a red, rough skin. Its translucent flesh, the aril, is edible; the seed is not.

sections.title: Food safety
sections.text: The seed contains MCPG and hypoglycin A, compounds associated with severe hypoglycaemia. Do not eat the seeds; unripe fruits have also been implicated in poisoning.
